summary:
Hatay Province stands under the national framework of Türkiye, and the source inventory holds no Hatay-specific incident, enforcement action, local ordinance, detention, facility practice or event ban affecting trans visitors. The province is not distinguished from the national position in any source reviewed.

Every claim available for this record, including criminalisation history, legal gender recognition, discrimination protection, military service rules, event bans and draft legislation, is recorded at national level only and is carried by the Türkiye record rather than repeated here.
tangentialFactors:
The sources assembled for this jurisdiction are national in scope: Amnesty International's Türkiye country report (Report 2025/26) and the Wikipedia national overview do not disaggregate their findings by province, so no comparison between Hatay and other Turkish provinces is supported by the inventory.

Because the recorded evidence describes state-level policy and practice, a visitor to Hatay would be assessed on the national pattern rather than on any locally documented treatment; nothing in the inventory indicates that Hatay is either better or worse than the country as a whole.
localsOnly:
No source documents a resident-facing fact specific to Hatay: no local administrative decision, police practice, healthcare arrangement, association registration or court proceeding concerning LGBT or trans residents of the province appears in the inventory.

How national frameworks are applied to Hatay residents by provincial authorities is therefore not sourced and cannot be characterised from this record.
outOfScopeNotes:
Whether any enforcement practice in Hatay diverges from the national pattern remains unresolved; no province-level reporting on detentions, event permissions or facility conditions was located in the inventory.

The status of draft legislation targeting LGBT people, and the reported February 2026 proposal concerning public encouragement of behaviour contrary to biological sex, are unresolved at national level in the sources and are not disaggregated to Hatay by any source.
